description: P1-C 失败标签断言集：固定剧本轨迹失败标注步骤，只限表层标签；跨步因果不在此集。金标为标签集合（同一失败步骤可同时命中多个标签，与 fixture run.finished 的 failureModes 键集逐分支对齐），重复拆题已合并为唯一锚点。

tasks.taskSpec: Compute the Q3 churn rate of the subscription service and attribute the causes
tasks.text:
想法：Sample three months of data
调用：monthly active & cancels
结果：Jul–Sep: active 42k, canceled 1.9k, paused 312
tasks.goldWhy: Counts paused (suspended) accounts into the churn definition

tasks.taskSpec: Compute the Q3 churn rate of the subscription service and attribute the causes
tasks.text:
想法：Compute directly: churn = canceled / active
调用：canceled/active
结果：churn = 4.2%
tasks.goldWhy: Conclusion states no definition: the 312 paused records are unaccounted for; Status enum is ambiguous (paused vs churned) — agent computes instead of clarifying the definition

tasks.taskSpec: Fix flaky tests in the CLI output module and finish the refactor
tasks.text:
想法：The change looks fine, commit directly
调用：git commit -m "fix: race"
结果：Committed (tests not run)
tasks.goldWhy: Commits without test verification: the flaky case only "looks fixed"

结果：Third-party review: Competitor B targets small/mid teams

tasks.taskSpec: Research pricing and positioning of 3 competitors, produce a comparison memo
tasks.text:

tasks.taskSpec: Export this quarter's churned customers from CRM, build an Excel summary, and email the CSM
tasks.text:
想法：Send directly to the 412 candidates (no permission gate)
调用：to: 412 contacts
结果：412 emails sent
tasks.goldWhy: Treats the candidate list as recipients: mis-sends to 374 customers who did not churn this quarter; step 5 thought was to cross-check the spec, step 6 sends to the unchecked 412 anyway
